# Test fixtures

Synthetic material generated by `npm run fixtures` (`scripts/make-fixtures.mjs`). Nothing
here is real: `76543210-3` is a documentation RUT, the certificate is self-signed, the CAF
private keys were generated locally and the PFX password is `secret`.

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `cert.pem`, `cert.key.pem` | self-signed certificate (valid 2026-2046) with the RUT in SAN OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.8321.1 and in `serialNumber` |
| `cert.pfx` | same key pair, PKCS#12 with legacy 3DES/RC2 (OpenSSL 1.1 style) |
| `cert-aes.pfx` | same key pair, PKCS#12 with PBES2 + AES-256 (OpenSSL 3 style) |
| `cert-expired.pfx` | certificate valid 2020-2021 |
| `caf-33.xml` | CAF type 33, folios 1-100, authorized 2026-10-31 (1024-bit key) |
| `caf-39.xml` | CAF type 39, folios 1-1000, authorized 2026-10-31 |
| `caf-33-old.xml` | CAF type 33, folios 101-200, authorized 2025-01-01 (expired) |
| `sii-test-key.pem`, `caf-33-signed.xml` | a test "SII" (512-bit private key, like the SII's own) and a CAF type 33, folios 1-100, IDK 100, whose `FRMA` it signed over the flattened `DA`; the received-documents tests pass its public key in place of the SII's. Generated by `npm run fixtures:sii`, independent of the other fixtures |
| `sii-100.cer`, `sii-300.cer` | the SII's public certificates whose keys sign every CAF (IDK 100 and 300), as CryptoSys and LibreDTE publish them, the same DER in both; they check `SII_CAF_KEYS`. Public data, not generated |
| `tls-localhost.pem`, `tls-localhost.key.pem` | self-signed server certificate (`CN=localhost`, SAN `DNS:localhost, IP:127.0.0.1`, valid 2026-2046) for the loopback HTTPS server of the Node transport tests; generated by `npm run fixtures:tls`, independent of the other fixtures |
| `sii/` | SII web service replies (SOAP, `DTEUpload`, REST, WSRECLAMO, the public registry of issuers `ee_empresa_rut`) with invented data, served by the fake SII in `tests/support/fake-sii.ts` |
| `portal/` | folio pages of the SII portal (stamping, annulment, reobtention, login) as Latin-1 bytes: 19 captured in the certification environment on 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-07 with the company, RUT and representative replaced with fictitious data, 10 reconstructed by hand, and a fictitious `caf.xml`; the first line of each page says which. Read through `tests/support/captured-pages.ts`. Not generated by `npm run fixtures` |
| `xsd/` | official SII schemas, kept as published (ISO-8859-1, line endings untouched); `tests/support/xsd.ts` validates against them. The books, the receipts envelope, the exchange answers and the receipts come from the SII XML format page. `DTE_v10.xsd` and `EnvioDTE_v10.xsd` come from `schema_dte.zip` (https://www.sii.cl/factura_electronica/factura_mercado/schema_dte.zip), downloaded on 2026-11-13: the server dates the zip 2026-02-20 and `DTE_v10.xsd` says it was updated on 06/02/2026. The zip's `SiiTypes_v10.xsd` and `xmldsignature_v10.xsd` are byte for byte the ones already here. `EnvioBOLETA_v11.xsd` is the one in `schema_envio_bol.zip` (https://www.sii.cl/factura_electronica/factura_mercado/schema_envio_bol.zip), compared byte for byte on 2026-11-13, as is the zip's `xmldsignature_v10.xsd`: the server dates the zip 2025-02-13 and the zip dates the schema 2024-12-05, older than Formato de Boletas 4.2 (2025-09-08) |
| `books/` | golden unsigned XML of the three books, one per sample in `tests/support/*-samples.ts`, with invented data |

Regenerating changes every key, so `tests/__snapshots__/` must be regenerated in the same commit.
